_comment: Parametric geometry driven by a named parameter. We define a=120 (cmd 'a=120' routes to a parameter assignment), draw two circles (ids 1 & 2) whose centers start 60 apart, FIX circle 1 (geometric .fix anchor so the solver moves the OTHER one), then bind a DIMENSIONAL distance constraint between the two centers to the expression 'a'. For a CIRCLE the distance constraint's point is its CENTER (Constraints.swift:45-46), so the solver translates circle 2 until the center-to-center distance equals a=120. The PNG shows the two circles separated by 120 (not the initial 60) — geometry sized by the parameter. NOTE: the dimensional-constraint glyph/value chip is canvas chrome and is NOT in the PNG; the proof is the re-solved separation.
